info.name: Graphite Platform Authentication GitHub App API

items.docs: Entry point to install the Graphite GitHub App on an organization. The installed app receives GitHub webhooks for CI status, mergeability, and push events and calls GitHub's APIs with fine-grained permissions and short-lived tokens. Served by GitHub, not by Graphite.
The Graphite listing on the GitHub Marketplace, from which an organization owner can install the app. Served by GitHub.
